description.title: מגבלות אחריות - פוליסה בסיסית
description.summary: This table details the limits of liability for a basic travel insurance policy. It shows coverage sections, the limit of liability for each, and the deductible amount.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מפרטת את מגבלות האחריות עבור פוליסת ביטוח נסיעות בסיסית של Harel Insurance Company Ltd. ניתן למצוא כאן את סעיפי הפוליסה השונים, גובה הכיסוי עבור כל סעיף, וההשתתפות העצמית הנדרשת. החיפוש נעשה לפי סעיף בפוליסה, סוג הכיסוי, גובה מגבלת האחריות וההשתתפות העצמית. לדוגמה, כיסוי הוצאות רפואיות בחו״ל במהלך אשפוז מוגבל בסכום של $5,000,000, ללא השתתפות עצמית. סעיפים נוספים כוללים פינוי רפואי, החזר הוצאות שהייה מעבר לתקופת הביטוח, וכרטיס טיסה לישראל. סכומים לדוגמה: $150 ליום עבור הוצאות לינה, $1,000 עבור כרטיס טיסה, ו-$2,500 עבור שהות מלווה.
notable_values: Flight and stay of an Escort: $2,500

טבלה: מגבלות אחריות - פוליסה בסיסית
This table details the limits of liability for a basic travel insurance policy. It shows coverage sections, the limit of liability for each, and the deductible amount.
ממדים: Section in Policy / Coverage, Limit of liability, Deductible

Limits of Liability Table for Part A - Basic Policy
Section in Policy,Coverage,Limit of liability,Deductible
Chapter 2 & Chapter 3,Insurer ' s limit of liability for Medical Expenses,"$5,000,000",
2.1,Medical Expenses Abroad during hospitalization,Included in Medical Expenses Liability Limit,Without Deductible
2.2.1,Land evacuation from place of Event to nearest Hospital,Included in Medical Expenses Liability Limit,Without Deductible
2.2.2,Air and/ or water evacuation from place of Event to nearest Hospital,Included in Medical Expenses Liability Limit,Without Deductible
2.3,Medical Flight to Israel,Included in Medical Expenses Liability Limit,Without Deductible
3.1,"Non-hospitalization Medical Expenses Abroad such as Physician , diagnostic tests",Included in Medical Expenses Liability Limit,Without Deductible
3.2,Medications,"$1,500",Without Deductible
3.3,Emergency dental treatment,$400,Without Deductible
3.4,Physiotherapy Abroad,$500 per treatment and up to 6 treatments,$50
3.5,Continued treatment in Israel as a result of an Accident that occurred Abroad,"$10,000 and up to 120 days",Without Deductible
3.5.1,"Cast removal, nail removal and physiotherapy in Israel",$6000 included in limit of liability of continued treatment in Israel,20% per treatment
Chapter 4,Special expenses,,
4.1,Reimbursement as a result of staying Abroad beyond the Period of Insurance,As specified below,Without Deductible
4.1.1,Accommodation expenses Abroad beyond the Period of Insurance for an Insured and/or an Escort,$150 per day,$50
4.1.2,Plane ticket to Israel for the Insured and/or an Escort,"$1,000",$50
4.2,Flight and stay of an Escort at the Insured ' s place of hospitalization Abroad,"$2,500",$50
4.3,Pregnancy first diagnosed Abroad,Included in Medical Expenses Liability Limit,
